description: NPC volition, romance and ambient life (packages/core/docs/npc-volition.md §3): what an NPC wants that nobody asked it for, how much that want is worth once disposition is counted, who it is aimed at, and which rung of the world’s courtship ladder opens it. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/volition/volition-predicates.ts verbatim and is regenerated by `npm run volition-corpus`. The pack is a COMPOSITION pack over the game-AI substrate: it reads target_kind/2 and agent_goal/3 and its decision layer writes agent_motive/3 and target_appeal/3, and it defines clauses for none of them — the cases here declare all four dynamic themselves, exactly as the shipped pack does, which is what lets them run standalone. A drive is desire_base/2 plus at most one disposition bonus, and the bonus is a COMPARISON against personality/3’s 0–1 fraction rather than a multiplication, because a drive four engines must agree on may not turn on a float. The ladder is authored — nothing here knows that a courtship goes attracted, courting, wed — a pair the world has recorded nothing about stand at rank 0, and volition_may_advance/3 is MUTUAL and one rung at a time, so a courtship one side wants stays a crush. Ambient life yields to agent_goal/3, which is the routine module’s own output: what an NPC does when nobody asked it to is what it does when nothing was asked of it. The whole of what volition contributes to behaviour is volition_proposal/4 — a drive and a target, which the decision layer writes as agent_motive/3 and target_appeal/3 for the substrate’s utility layer to weigh and permissible/3 to gate. There is no volition action, no volition score and no volition gate, because a want that could pick an action would be the fourth selection mechanism the module exists to retire. What is NOT here is the gate itself: permissible/3 belongs to conformance/prolog/agent-ai.json, and that an impermissible want is discarded however highly it is rated is proved end to end in src/volition/__tests__/permissibility.test.ts.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-offers-no-want-and-does-not-raise
kb: volition_rank(A, B, R) :- romantic_status(A, B, S), courtship_stage(S, R).
volition_may_advance(A, B, S) :- nonvar(A), nonvar(B), courtship_stage(S, R), volition_rank(A, B, Cur), R =:= Cur + 1, stage_threshold(S, Need), spark(A, B, X), X >= Need, spark(B, A, Y), Y >= Need.
volition_pull(A, D, Bonus) :- desire_trait(D, Trait, Above, Bonus), personality(A, Trait, V), V > Above, !.
volition_drive(A, D, Drive) :- nonvar(A), desire_base(D, Base), volition_pull(A, D, Pull), Raw is Base + Pull, volition_clamp(Raw, Drive).
volition_yielding(A) :- ambient_yield(P), agent_goal(A, _, Q), Q >= P.
volition_target(A, D, T) :- desire_target_kind(D, Kind), target_kind(T, Kind), T \== A.
volition_stage_met(A, T, D) :- desire_stage(D, S), courtship_stage(S, Need), volition_rank(A, T, R), R >= Need.
volition_proposal(A, D, T, Drive) :- nonvar(A), desire(D, _), volition_active(A, D), \+ desire_spent(A, D), volition_target(A, D, T), volition_stage_met(A, T, D), volition_drive(A, D, Drive).
volition_motive(A, M, Drive) :- volition_proposal(A, D, _, Drive), desire(D, M).
volition_appeal(A, T, V) :- nonvar(A), spark(A, T, V).
volition_candidate(A, Act, T) :- volition_proposal(A, D, T, _), desire_action(D, Act).

volition_may_advance(A, B, S) :- nonvar(A), nonvar(B), courtship_stage(S, R), volition_rank(A, B, Cur), R =:= Cur + 1, stage_threshold(S, Need), spark(A, B, X), X >= Need, spark(B, A, Y), Y >= Need.
volition_pull(A, D, Bonus) :- desire_trait(D, Trait, Above, Bonus), personality(A, Trait, V), V > Above, !.
volition_drive(A, D, Drive) :- nonvar(A), desire_base(D, Base), volition_pull(A, D, Pull), Raw is Base + Pull, volition_clamp(Raw, Drive).
volition_yielding(A) :- ambient_yield(P), agent_goal(A, _, Q), Q >= P.
volition_target(A, D, T) :- desire_target_kind(D, Kind), target_kind(T, Kind), T \== A.
volition_stage_met(A, T, D) :- desire_stage(D, S), courtship_stage(S, Need), volition_rank(A, T, R), R >= Need.
volition_proposal(A, D, T, Drive) :- nonvar(A), desire(D, _), volition_active(A, D), \+ desire_spent(A, D), volition_target(A, D, T), volition_stage_met(A, T, D), volition_drive(A, D, Drive).
volition_motive(A, M, Drive) :- volition_proposal(A, D, _, Drive), desire(D, M).
volition_appeal(A, T, V) :- nonvar(A), spark(A, T, V).
volition_candidate(A, Act, T) :- volition_proposal(A, D, T, _), desire_action(D, Act).
